title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Cards V5 Gameplay Schema

id.description: Set prefix and padded card number (e.g., "a1-001").

name.description: The printed name of the card.

subtype.description: Energy type for Pokémon. Item classification for Trainers.

stage.description: Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2. Null for Trainers.

evolves_from.description: The name of the required pre-evolution Pokémon.

special_tags.description: Tags like "ancient", "future", or "ultra_beasts". Defaults to null.

health.description: The maximum hit points. Null for Trainers.

retreat.description: The energy cost to retreat. Null for Trainers.

weakness.description: The energy type the Pokémon is weak to.

exists.description: True if the card has an ability.

name.description: The printed name of the ability.

effect.description: The mechanical effect text of the ability.

attacks.description: Contains keys `1` and `2`. Each holds `cost`, `name`, `damage` (integer), and `effect` (string).

card_text.description: The mechanical rules text for Trainer cards.

points.description: Points awarded to the opponent when knocked out (1, 2, or 3).

ex.description: True if the card is an "ex" rulebox Pokémon.

mega.description: True if the card is a Mega Evolution.

deckBuilderNr.description: The internal integer used by the game client for deck rendering.

attack.description: A single attack on a Pokémon card.

cost.description: The energy cost symbols required to use the attack.

name.description: The printed name of the attack.

damage.description: The base damage value of the attack.

effect.description: The additional effect text of the attack.
